thread:
alia: quick check - added a compact-cluster scrubber prototype in figma. goal: let users preview past traffic during timeline scrubbing without expanding every version. link: https://figma.redwood/compact-scrub

ben: neat. question: how does the scrubber surface multiple minor releases inside a cluster? currently shows a tiny stacked bar but unclear on keyboard focus.

carmen: suggest a condensed list that appears when cluster is focused. one-line per version, with 'view diff' link. chevron button toggles on click/Enter. avoids hover-only.

ryan: agree. keyboard pattern should use aria-expanded on the chevron and move focus into the condensed list when opened. also add J/K nav to move between versions.

mona: copy nit: condensed row format: 'v2.3.1  3 files changed  deployed by @ben  1h ago' (use em-dash). keep it single line.

alia: accessibility: ensure scrubber previews have role="status" updates, and any destructive actions (rollback) open an alertdialog with type-to-confirm. no inline rollback buttons in prod clusters.

ben: dev: we'll show a quick 'Rollback' icon in staging only. for prod it's in the expanded panel behind confirm modal. keeps risk low.

carmen: also contrast on the small pills failing AA at 12px. bump text or darken bg. I'll update tokens.

ryan: storybook task: I'll add stories for cluster expand, keyboard nav, and scrubber preview. include tests for focus trap and aria-expanded.

mona: can we add a small tooltip "Press R to rollback (confirm required)" in the help panel when shortcuts are enabled? must be opt-in.

alia: yes - opt-in shortcuts with accessible help. designbot: created task (#5012) for compact-cluster scrubber review. reminders in 48h. (reaction: :white_check_mark:)

ben: thanks all. i'll prototype the staging inline icon and wireframe the prod guarded flow. aiming for handoff next week.
